_comment: Response bodies, derived by reading app/routers/ and app/services/. NOT machine-generated: FastAPI declares no response_model, so the OpenAPI schema types every success response as an empty object. Merged into the endpoint pages by generate_reference.py. Update when a service's return shape changes.

GET /health.note: Polled by the Electron manager during startup; `session_id` changes on every backend restart.

POST /api/project/create.note: Every project is created with a `main` scenario.

GET /api/project/{project_id}.note: The boot saga's first call — it is what tells the app which scenario to initialise.

GET /api/project/{project_id}/scenarios/.note: `done` means hydration finished, so every other scenario-scoped endpoint is now safe to call.

POST /api/project/{project_id}/scenarios.note: `discarded` is false when no live context existed — the call is idempotent. `?save=false` releases WITHOUT writing context.xml.

GET /api/catalog/object-types.note: Drives the dynamic properties form. See [The property system](../../arch/properties.md).

POST /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/.note: A create whose engine build fails deletes the row and raises, so you never get a DB-only object.

PATCH /api/geometry/project/{project_id}.note: A superseded request (a newer PATCH for the same object arrived first) returns the object unchanged without writing.

GET /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/s.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).
Binary buffer — geometry wire format v2 (`packGPUBuffers`). See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

Fetching hydrates the scenario — use this as the first viewport load. Returns **499** if the client disconnects mid-pack.

GET /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/s.note: `member_ids` is authoritative for membership and child order.

DELETE /api/geometry/project/{project_id.note: Deletes the group only — its members are ungrouped, not deleted.

GET /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/s.note: `source` is `library` when sync=1, `frozen` when sync=0. A `stale: true` flag appears when the library group was deleted.

DELETE /api/geometry/project/{project_id.note: Idempotent — an already-absent assignment also returns `already_absent: true`.

GET /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/s.note: Dry run — reports drift without changing anything.

PUT /api/geometry/project/{project_id}/s.note: Conflicts are skipped and reported, never raised — partial success is normal.

POST /api/materials/library/groups.note: A material is created EMPTY; add one member per material type afterwards.

PUT /api/materials/library/groups/{group.note: With `?scenario_id=` the active scenario is reconciled and repainted in the same call.

POST /api/materials/library/groups/{grou.note: One member per material type per group — a duplicate is refused with DUPLICATE_MATERIAL_TYPE_IN_GROUP.

PUT /api/materials/library/groups/{group.note: Full replacement of that member's properties.

POST /api/materials/library/groups/{grou.note: Creates the member in texture mode if it does not exist yet.
Does NOT create the member — the card must already be saved. The caller stages this path and the member's own Save persists it.

GET /api/materials/library/groups/{group.note: Reads the `<globaldata_vec2 label=…>` entries out of a STORED file.

DELETE /api/materials/library/groups/{gr.note: 409 FILE_IN_USE while any material or frozen snapshot still references it.

GET /api/weather/project/{project_id}/sc.note: Weather values live in the PyHelios context, not in SQLite.

POST /api/weather/project/{project_id}/s.note: Multipart upload; normalized in Python, streamed through a temp file, bulk-loaded with loadTabularTimeseriesData.

PATCH /api/weather/project/{project_id}/.note: The column is identified by `column_id` in the PATH — do not repeat it in the body.

POST /api/weather/project/{project_id}/s.note: ALL-OR-NOTHING: one already-deleted row 404s the whole batch, which is why the caller passes skipScopeCheck.

PUT /api/weather/project/{project_id}/sc.note: Atomic replacement. The chosen unit must belong to the header's data type — enforced here, not by SQLite.

GET /api/geometry/all/binary.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

POST /api/geometry/binary.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

GET /api/geometry/all/gpu.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v2 (`packGPUBuffers`). See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

GET /api/objects/{object_id}/geometry/bi.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

GET /api/objects/{object_id}/geometry/gp.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v2 (`packGPUBuffers`). See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

GET /api/objects/{object_id}/children/bi.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v1. See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

GET /api/objects/{object_id}/children/gp.example: Binary buffer — geometry wire format v2 (`packGPUBuffers`). See [Geometry & primitives](../../../concepts/primitives.md).

POST /api/plantarch/canopy/stream.example: Server-Sent Events reporting build progress, terminating on a `done` event.

POST /api/import/obj.note: BROKEN: import_service calls get_context() with no argument against a signature that requires one — this raises TypeError and returns 500.
